g.text: Adding a recipe: selected class relationships
Recipe(name, calories, protein, carbs, fats, ingredients)
GroceryItem(name: String, quantity: BigDecimal, unit: String)
Only feature-relevant members and relationships are shown; some parameter types are abbreviated.
Solid arrows show stored references, with private role names and target-end multiplicities.
Reverse multiplicities are unspecified. Each reference is shown once, not repeated as an attribute.
Dashed arrows show dependencies; the hollow triangle denotes interface realization.
RecipeBook and RecipeViewer are not stored AddRecipeCommand fields.
Plain associations avoid implying exclusive ownership of shared objects.
Static constants, validation helpers inside Recipe, and library classes are omitted.
